function.arguments: {"observation": "The reviewer pointed out a critical error: I divided batch B `biomarker_final` values by 10, assuming 1 µg/L = 10 ng/mL, but the correct conversion is 1 µg/L = 1 ng/mL. This means the values in batch B are already in ng/mL, and dividing by 10 was incorrect.", "implication": "The entire analysis is based on a wrong unit correction. The `biomarker_final` values from batch B are already in ng/mL, so dividing them by 10 was incorrect and biased the average change. I must recompute the change without dividing batch B values. This changes the method and requires a full re-run of the analysis."}
function.name: note_finding
